Resolves #21217

🌿 A stylesheet that means one thing to Sass and another to the browser can no longer be written here.

**Merge condition (AC-7):** merges the same day as the Institution's (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#1013) and the private package's conversions.

The engine's 722 theme sources are plain CSS in `resources/css`, and `build-themes` / `watch-themes` copy them through autoprefixer (plus cssnano for esm and production) instead of compiling. Sass and postcss-scss leave the engine. URLs, the theme map and the loader are unchanged. Packages declare `"neo": {"css": "<dir>"}`; a workspace's `resources/css` replaces `resources/scss`.

Evidence: L3 (browser computed-style census against the Sass build; a child-window tear-out in a fresh workspace; converter proof in two readings; unit suite) → L3 required (AC-2, AC-5). AC-7 is the merge condition.

Decision Record: OPTIONAL (#21210's STEP_BACK, point 1).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Converter at `825047c9ea` (commit `9955e13cc6`, `buildScripts/helpers/convertScssToCss.mjs`): 722 of 722 equal under Sass AND under a plain nesting reading (`test/playwright/util/flattenCss.mjs`); D2/D3 flatten 15 files in place; Euclid's shorthand falsifier is the built-in negative control. |
| AC-2 | `themes.spec`, `watchThemes.spec` (CI). Browser census, `dist/development/css` vs the Sass build of `825047c9ea`: portal 2,478,837 computed values (pseudo-elements included), Workstation 757,880, Colors 185,408 — 0 differences (8 portal widths moved while the web font reloaded during the swap and re-measure equal). After review (`c777f0e682`), against `2a4c8c5cad`: Workstation 764,180 values with a synthetic column-drag proxy appended, 0 differences; each news view's sheets in load order (`content/Component.css` first) give the same flat rule sequence. After the dev merge (`b2ad4ccaaa`), against dev's straight conversion of `Viewport.scss`: Workstation 782,100 values (default) and 616,375 (planning desk), 0 differences. |
| AC-3 | `npm ls sass postcss-scss --package-lock-only` is empty; no build script imports either. A generated workspace's own `sass` pin goes with create-app's 14.0 scaffold (Out of Scope here). |
| AC-4 | The map from the `.css` tree is byte-identical to the Sass map at `5302f2bb96`; in the final tree it lacks only four entries no class requests (`Neo.design-tokens.*`, `Neo.global.MouseCursor`); since `c777f0e682`, `apps.portal.news.tickets.Component` has no sheet (its rules are `apps.portal.content.Component`'s `src`) and `Neo.dashboard.dock.interaction.Preview` lists only `src`; three component specs loaded the token sheets by path and now load each neo theme's `Global.css` (`2a4c8c5cad`). Add/rename/delete: `themes.spec`, `watchThemes.spec` (CI). |
| AC-5 | A fresh workspace outside the engine, with the engine linked at `2a4c8c5cad`, one workspace class and one package that declares `"neo": {"css": "resources/css"}`. Its `build-themes` copies all three roots (717 sheets: 715 + 1 + 1), and the map lists `Neo.button.Base`, `apps.witness.Panel` and `apps.witnesspkg.Badge`. A dashboard tears its panel out into a child window (`openWidgetInPopup`). That panel nests a container holding an engine button, the workspace class and the package class. The child window's document loads `css/src/button/Base.css`, `css/src/apps/witness/Panel.css` and `css/src/apps/witnesspkg/Badge.css` and paints all three: the button's `display: flex`, both outline colours, and the `&::after` content of the natively nested rules. The main window no longer holds the container. The only console errors come from Font Awesome, which this hand-made workspace never installed. |
| AC-6 | Every reader in the ticket's list reads `.css` (commit `9955e13cc6`; four comments and CONTRIBUTING in `d05c00cba2`); the three theme lints pass on the converted tree; unit suite 7,824 passed at `d05c00cba2`. |
| AC-7 | Open: paired merge (top of body). |

## Deltas from ticket
- **One authority where plain CSS has one** (`5d1814710f`): the motion vocabulary moves from five per-theme copies into `src/Global.css`, declared once for every `neo-theme-*` root (no other rule declares a motion token, so no computed value moves); the standalone design-token and `global/MouseCursor` sheets, which no class requests (three component specs loaded the token sheets by path; `2a4c8c5cad` points them at each neo theme's `Global.css`), go with `convertDesignTokens.mjs`, whose output predates #18747's hand edits. The blocks the Sass sources shared through `@use` and mixins keep one home each (`c777f0e682`): the news timeline structure in the sheet of the three views' base `Portal.view.content.Component`, the preview accents in each theme's dashboard Container sheet (Preview declares `additionalThemeFiles`, as DropIndicators does), and Workstation's grid blocks as flat selector lists naming the viewport and the column-drag proxy. DockRailRevealRetarget's four keyframe pairs were one `@each`; they are hand-written twins now, kept by that spec's own arm.
- **D4 flattens in place:** only the 11 control-flow nodes of `dashboard/Container.css` take Sass's output; its other 32 stay as authored.
- **The converter checks what Sass hides:** a browser-model equality arm; Sass nested properties expand (portal References' `background: {…}`, which a browser drops whole); a trailing-comma selector in Range is fixed; Sass imports, placeholders and `@at-root` left in output fail the run.
- `create/scss.mjs` becomes `create/css.mjs`; `moveStyleTransforms` rewrites relative CSS `@import` URLs, the one module reference plain CSS has.

## Test Evidence
- Converter receipts as in AC-1 (both readings), and the tree at `2a4c8c5cad`, base plus `5d1814710f`'s edits: 715 of 715. `c777f0e682` then moves and deletes copies on purpose; its proof is the cascade receipt in AC-2. The sheets dev added or changed since the branch point are the converter's output on the merged dev commit: six at `37c0a995dc` (`b2ad4ccaaa`, 728 of 728 in both readings), four at `0ca5b2dec2` (`4980924e0e`, 731 of 731), three at `d21834e27d` (`d111345276`, 733 of 733), whose `dev` also deleted the covid example and with it the sheet this branch had renamed, and four at `d49f1dd494` (`f413710c29`, 734 of 734).
- Dist equivalence vs the Sass build: development 722 of 722 equal once flattened; esm/production 720 of 722 equal declaration by declaration with the same override order, the other two differing only where cssnano kept `center` for `50%` and where one identical declaration is duplicated.
- `flattenCss` agrees with Sass on all 715 sheets; the two specs that compiled with Sass use it now.
